scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator introduces a solution for kitchen odors while a woman cooks in the background of a modern kitchen.
scene_timeline.audio_description: If you're cooking up a stinky meal tonight like we are, let me introduce you to something.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Close-up of a clear glass Lampe Berger; creator removes the cap and lights the ceramic burner with a long-reach lighter.
scene_timeline.audio_description: This is a Lampe Berger. Just gotta take that off, light it up, let it go for two minutes.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator blows out the flame and points to the ceramic burner, explaining how the alcohol-based scent diffuses.
scene_timeline.audio_description: So once two minutes is up, you just gotta blow it out and then this ceramic piece that we were just burning, it's gonna start emitting the alcohol-based scent in there. This one's Ocean Breeze. Very, very yummy.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Creator places the decorative silver cap back on the lamp and gives a thumbs up to the camera.
scene_timeline.audio_description: And I gotta say, this makes the best housewarming gift. Ciao!

items.name: Remove Caps
items.details: Take off the decorative silver cap and the small solid extinguishing cap.

items.name: Light the Burner
items.details: Use a lighter to ignite the ceramic burner at the top of the wick.

items.name: Timed Burn
items.details: Allow the flame to burn for exactly two minutes.

items.name: Extinguish Flame
items.details: Blow out the flame; the ceramic burner will remain hot and begin diffusing scent.

items.name: Replace Decorative Cap
items.details: Put the vented decorative cap back on to allow the fragrance to spread safely.
